correctness.rationale: Bounded-degree Hanf locality gives finite radius R and count threshold T. Every full-plane or single-side half-plane colored rooted type appears at increasing numbers of disjoint candidate sites with fixed positive occurrence probability and hence saturates counts with probability→1; the nonrepeatable types occur only within R of both perpendicular boundaries, so four L=2R+1 corner patches determine all unsaturated counts. Four patches are independent for large sides, yielding integer-coefficient p-polynomials. Each vertex at inward distances (j,j) from a corner is first-order definable via distance 2j and maximal fixed number binom(2j,j) of shortest corner paths. Four independent corner code words of t fair bits form alphabet size 2^t, and S4 orbit sizes 1,4,6,12,24 have gap-free subset sums, proving all dyadic rationals attained for sufficiently large dimensions. Independent orbit-subset and diagonal-binomial counts support, not replace, locality proof.
